dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 0.9:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

other_distinctive_markers: Saturated cyan-teal bioluminescent glow with high-intensity white light patches along the dorsal and mid-lateral regions.
